title: Tanvir and the Marketing Team
story: Tanvir works in the marketing team of a travel company in Chattogram. His team leader is Ms. Farzana, and he shares an office with Mitu and Arif. This month they are preparing a big campaign for a new client in Dhaka.
storyBn: তানভীর চট্টগ্রামের একটি ট্রাভেল কোম্পানির মার্কেটিং টিমে কাজ করে। তার টিম লিডার ফারজানা ম্যাডাম, আর সে মিতু ও আরিফের সাথে একই রুমে বসে। এই মাসে তারা ঢাকার এক নতুন ক্লায়েন্টের জন্য একটি বড় প্রচারণার প্রস্তুতি নিচ্ছে।

units.focus: Describe Tanvir's job, team and weekly routine
units.focusBn: তানভীরের কাজ, দল ও সাপ্তাহিক রুটিন বর্ণনা করা

sessions.pattern: Subject + is/are ... / Subject + verb(s) + object + time/place.
sessions.tipBn: নিয়মিত কাজ ও স্থায়ী তথ্য বোঝাতে present simple হয়; he, she হলে verb-এ s যোগ হয়।

items.en: Tanvir works in the marketing team.
The office opens at nine from Sunday to Thursday.
Ms. Farzana is the team leader, and she is very organized.
Tanvir usually answers client emails in the morning.
We have a short team meeting every Sunday.
Mitu and Arif share an office with Tanvir.

sessions.tipBn: be verb-এর পরে not বসে; অন্য verb-এর আগে don't বা doesn't বসে, আর doesn't-এর পরে verb-এ s থাকে না।

items.en: Tanvir doesn't work in the finance team.
The office doesn't open on Fridays.
Ms. Farzana isn't strict, but she is very fair.
Arif doesn't like long meetings.
We don't use paper files anymore.
Mitu doesn't take the bus to work.

sessions.tipBn: Do/Does অথবা Is/Are বাক্যের শুরুতে বসিয়ে হ্যাঁ/না প্রশ্ন হয়।

items.en: Does Tanvir work in the marketing team?
Do you have a team meeting every Sunday?
Is Ms. Farzana free this afternoon?
Does Tanvir answer client emails in the morning?
Do you need a password for the Wi-Fi?
Is the meeting room on this floor?

sessions.tipBn: Don't, Doesn't, Isn't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন শুরু করলে বোঝায় আমরা হ্যাঁ উত্তর আশা করছি বা একটু অবাক হয়েছি।

items.en: Doesn't the office open at nine?
Isn't Ms. Farzana the team leader?
Don't you like working with Arif?
Doesn't Mitu share an office with you?
Isn't the client meeting on Tuesday?
Don't we have a deadline this week?

sessions.pattern: Wh-word + do/does + subject + verb? / Wh-word + is/are ...?
sessions.tipBn: তথ্য জানতে প্রশ্নের শুরুতে What, Where, Who, How, Which বসে, তারপর do/does বা is।

items.en: What time does the office open?
Who leads the marketing team?
How does Tanvir get to work?
Where do you keep the printer paper?
How often does the team meet?
Which client does Mitu work with?

units.focus: Talk about tasks in progress this week
units.focusBn: এখন ও এই সপ্তাহে চলমান কাজ নিয়ে বলা

sessions.pattern: Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing (+ now / this week).
sessions.tipBn: এই মুহূর্তে বা এই সময়টায় চলমান কাজ বোঝাতে am/is/are + verb-ing হয়।

items.en: Tanvir is preparing slides for the client meeting.
Mitu is designing a new poster this week.
Arif is fixing a problem with his laptop.
Ms. Farzana is talking to a client on a video call.
We are working on a big campaign this month.
The new intern is sitting at the empty desk.

sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক করতে am/is/are-এর পরে not বসে, তারপর verb-ing।

items.en: Tanvir isn't preparing the slides alone.
Mitu isn't answering her phone right now.
Arif isn't using his own laptop today.
Ms. Farzana isn't taking calls at the moment.
We aren't working on the website this month.
The air conditioner isn't working again.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে am/is/are subject-এর আগে বসে।

items.en: Is Tanvir preparing slides for the client meeting?
Is Mitu designing the new poster?
Are you using the meeting room now?
Is Arif still fixing his laptop?
Are you waiting for the client's reply?
Is the new intern learning quickly?

sessions.tipBn: প্রথমে Wh-word, তারপর am/is/are, subject এবং verb-ing বসে।

items.en: What is Tanvir preparing for the meeting?
Who is Ms. Farzana talking to?
Which project are you working on this week?
Why is Arif working from home today?
How is the new intern doing?
What are Mitu and Arif discussing?

units.focus: Talk about last week and the client presentation
units.focusBn: গত সপ্তাহের কাজ ও ক্লায়েন্ট প্রেজেন্টেশন নিয়ে বলা

sessions.tipBn: অতীতের কাজ বলতে regular verb-এ -ed যোগ হয়, আর irregular verb-এর আলাদা রূপ আছে, যেমন gave, sent, went।

items.en: Tanvir gave a presentation to the client last Tuesday.
The client liked our ideas.
Mitu sent the final design on Wednesday.
Arif stayed late to finish the report.
Ms. Farzana thanked the whole team in the meeting.
We went out for dinner after work.

sessions.tipBn: অতীতের না-বোধক বাক্যে didn't-এর পরে verb মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: Tanvir didn't give the presentation alone.
The client didn't like the colors at first.
Mitu didn't send the design on time.
Arif didn't leave the office before nine.
Nobody missed the meeting on Sunday.
I didn't see your message yesterday.

sessions.tipBn: অতীতের প্রশ্নে Did শুরুতে বসে এবং verb মূল রূপে থাকে।

items.en: Did Tanvir give the presentation last Tuesday?
Did the client like our ideas?
Did Mitu send the final design?
Did you back up the files?
Did Ms. Farzana approve the budget?
Did everyone get the meeting invitation?

sessions.tipBn: Didn't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন করলে বোঝায় আমরা হ্যাঁ উত্তর আশা করছি বা অবাক হয়েছি।

items.en: Didn't Tanvir give a great presentation?
Didn't Arif stay late on Wednesday?
Didn't you get my email this morning?
Didn't Ms. Farzana thank the whole team?
Didn't the client call back?
Didn't we save the file on the shared drive?

sessions.pattern: Wh-word + did + subject + verb (base)? / Who + verb (past)?
sessions.tipBn: Wh-word-এর পরে did ও verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে; Who কর্তা হলে did লাগে না।

items.en: When did Tanvir give the presentation?
What did the client say about the colors?
Why did Arif stay so late?
Who designed the new poster?
Where did you put the contract?
How long did the meeting last?

units.focus: Talk about plans for the new campaign

sessions.tipBn: আগে থেকে ঠিক করা পরিকল্পনা বা স্পষ্ট লক্ষণ দেখে ভবিষ্যৎ বলতে be going to + verb ব্যবহার হয়।

items.en: Tanvir is going to visit the client next week.
Mitu is going to design three social media posts.
We are going to launch the campaign in May.
Ms. Farzana is going to hire a new designer.
Look at the time! We're going to miss the meeting.
I'm going to take two days off in June.

sessions.pattern: Subject + am not/isn't/aren't going to + verb (base) ...
sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক পরিকল্পনা বোঝাতে am/is/are-এর পরে not going to বসে।

items.en: Tanvir isn't going to visit the client alone.
We aren't going to launch the campaign in April.
Ms. Farzana isn't going to hire anyone this month.
I'm not going to take leave in December.
Arif isn't going to work from home tomorrow.
The old printer isn't going to last much longer.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে am/is/are শুরুতে বসে, তারপর subject ও going to।

items.en: Is Tanvir going to visit the client next week?
Are we going to launch the campaign in May?
Is Ms. Farzana going to hire a new designer?
Are you going to take any days off?
Is Mitu going to join the video call?
Is it going to be a long meeting?

sessions.pattern: Wh-word + am/is/are + subject + going to + verb (base)?
sessions.tipBn: প্রথমে Wh-word, তারপর am/is/are, subject, going to এবং verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে।

items.en: When is Tanvir going to visit the client?
What are we going to call the campaign?
Who is going to write the report?
Where are you going to stay in Dhaka?
How are we going to reach young travelers?
How much are we going to spend on ads?
